name: standmeet-dsh-acceptance
description: Real-DSH acceptance tests for the blocks in ../plugins. dsh-testkit lives here (one install); each <block>.dsh-testkit.yaml points its subject.source back at ../plugins/<block> (no copying). A green run proves the unmodified block + its cordis.patch.yml declaration mounts on a real DSH, registers its tools, and works — i.e. it is a valid dsh plugin with zero adaptation.
